senses.gloss:
लघट् लघट्, ट्, or लघटि, इस्, m. (accord-
ing to Uṇādi-s. I. 134. fr. rt. लङ्घ्), air, wind.
लघन्ती, f., N. of a river, (also read लङ्घती.)

लघय, Nom. P. लघयति, &c., to make light,
lighten, lessen, diminish, alleviate, mitigate, soften.

लघु लघु, उस्, -घ्वी or उस्, उ (a later form
of रघु, q. v.; according to Uṇādi-s. I. 30. fr. rt.
लङ्घ्), quick, swift, fleet, rapid, light, nimble,
active; epithet of a particular mode of flying (pe-
culiar to birds); epithet of the Nakṣatras Hasta,
Aśvinī, and Puṣya; light, easy, not difficult or
heavy; easy of digestion; (in prosody) short or
light (i. e. a light vowel as opposed to a गुरु
or heavy, the proper term for a short vowel being
ह्रस्व); lightly pronounced (said of the pronunci-
ation of व, as opposed to मध्यम and गुरु);
little, small, narrow, diminutive, slight, unimportant,
trivial, insignificant, trifling, of little worth or esti-
mation; weak, feeble, wretched, low, lowly, humble,
mean, contemptible, vain, frivolous; sapless, pithless;
young, younger; soft, low, gentle (as sound; op-
posed to अ-लघु, loud); pleasing, agreeable, plea-
sant, handsome, beautiful; clean, pure; (उ), ind.
quickly, rapidly, swiftly; lightly, easily, &c.; con-
temptibly, (लघु मन्, to think lightly of, despise);
(उस्), f. Trigonella Corniculata; (घ्वी), f. a slender
or delicate woman; a light carriage; Trigonella Cor-
niculata; (उ), n. a particular measure of time (= 15
Kāṣṭhās = (1/15) Nāḍikā); Agallochum, a particular
kind of Agallochum; the root of Andropogon Muri-
catus; [cf. Gr. ἐλαχύ-ς, ἐλαφρός, λαγώς: Lat. lev-
i-s, levi-ta-s, levare, lepus (for old lephus): Goth.
leihts: Old Germ. lîhti: Angl. Sax. lîght: Slav.
lig-u-ku: Lith. lengva-s: Hib. lag, ‘weak, feeble,
faint;’ lagudhadh, ‘diminution, weakening;’ la-
guighthe, ‘weakened, lessened;’ laghad, ‘fewness,
weakness;’ lagaighim, ‘I weaken;’ laigidh, laigse,
laigsinn, ‘weakness, infirmity;’ lugh, ‘little, swift,
active;’ lughad, ‘littleness.]’
—लघु-कङ्कोल, अस्,
m. Pimenta Acris.
—लघु-कण्टका, f. Mimosa
Pudica.
—लघु-कर्कन्धु, उस्, m. f. a small
kind of Zizyphus.
—लघु-कर्णी, f. a species of
plant (= Marāṭhī मोरवेल).
—लघु-काय, अस्,
आ, अम्, light-bodied; (अस्), m. a goat.
—लघु-
काश्मर्य, अस्, m. a kind of tree.
—लघु-कोष्ठ,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a light stomach, having little in
the stomach.
—लघु-कौमुदी, f. ‘the short Kau-
mudī, ‘N. of an epitome of the Siddhānta-kaumudī

—लघु-क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having
a quick or rapid step, going quickly, hastening;
(अम्), ind. with quick step, quickly, hastily.
—ल-
घु-क्रिया, f. a small event, trifle.
—लघु-ख-
ट्विका, f. a small bedstead or couch, easy chair.
—लघु-खर्तर, N. of a family.
—लघु-
गङ्गाधर, अस्, m. a particular powder or medi-
cine (used in diarrhœa).
—लघु-गर्ग, अस्, m. a
species of fish (probably a variety of the Pimelodus).
—लघु-गोधूम, अस्, m. a small kind of wheat.
—लघु-ग्रह-मञ्जरि, इस्, f., N. of an astrolo-
gical work.
—लघु-चन्द्रिका, f., N. of a com-

mentary by Brahmānanda-sarasvatī on the Advaita-
siddhi (described as a refutation of the Nyāya theory
from the point of view of the Vedānta).
—लघु-
चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, light-minded, little-minded, having
little thought, thoughtless, frivolous, fickle, unsteady.
—लघुचित्त-ता, f. light-mindedness, thoughtless-
ness, fickleness.
—लघु-चित्र-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
light and ready-handed.
—लघु-चिन्तन, अम्, n.,
N. of an epitome of the Mīmāṃsā Sūtras by Rāghava-
deva.
—लघु-चिन्तामणि-रस, अस्, m. epithet of
a particular fluid mixture.
—लघु-चिर्भिटा, f. co-
locynth.
—लघु-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, little-minded,
low-minded, frivolous.
—लघु-च्छदा, f. a kind
of asparagus.
—लघु-च्छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, easy to
be cut, easy to be extirpated, easily annihilated or
destroyed.
—लघु-जङ्गल, अस्, m. a sort of quail

—लघु-जातक, अम्, n., N. of a short
work by Varāha-mihira on horoscopes.
—लघु-
जातिविवेक, अस्, m. ‘the short Jāti-viveka,’ N. of a
work.
—लघु-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more quick, lighter,
easier, &c. (= लघीयस्).
—लघु-ता, f. or लघु-
त्व, अम्, n. quickness, rapidity, agility, activity;
lightness, levity, ease, facility; shortness; smallness,
littleness, lowness, meanness, insignificance, unim-
portance, thoughtlessness, levity, frivolity; wanton-
ness; want of rank or dignity, humbleness of origin;
disregard, disrespect.
—लघु-दन्ती, f. a small kind
of Croton.
—लघु-दीपिका, f., N. of a commen-
tary.
—लघु-दुन्दुभि, इस्, m. a small drum.
—लघु-द्राक्षा, f. a small stoneless grape (com-
monly called Kishmish).
—लघु-द्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ,
fusing or liquefying easily, flowing rapidly (said of
quicksilver).
—लघु-द्वारवती, f. the young or
recent Dvāra-vatī, i. e. the more modern part of the
town.
—लघु-नाभ-मण्डल, अम्, n., N. of a
particular mystical circle.
—लघु-नामन्, अ, n.
Agallochum.
—लघु-नारदीय, अम्, n. the short
Nāradīya.
—लघु-न्याय-सुधा, f., N. of a com-
mentary on the Śata-ślokī.
—लघु-न्यास, अस्, m.,
N. of a grammatical treatise.
—लघु-पञ्चमूल,
अम्, n. the smaller Pañca-mula, q. v.
—लघु-पण्-
डित, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—लघु-पतनक,
अस्, m. ‘quickly flying, lightly falling,’ N. of a crow
(in the Hitopadeśa).
—लघु-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. a
kind of plant (= रोचनी).
—लघु-पत्त्र-फला,
f. = लघूदुम्बरिका.
—लघु-पत्त्री, f. a species
of plant.
—लघु-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work.
—लघु-पराशर, अस्, m. the shorter Parāśara.
—लघु-परिभाषा-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a short
commentary on the grammatical Paribhāṣās.
—ल-
घु-पर्णी, f. = लघु-कर्णी.
—लघु-पाक, अस्,
m. easy digestion, digestibility; (अस्, आ, अम्), easy
of digestion, easily digested.
—लघु-पाकिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, easily digested.
—लघु-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
quickly flying, lightly falling or alighting; (ई), m.,
N. of a crow.
—लघु-पिच्छिल, अस्, m. Cordia

—लघु-पुलस्त्य, अस्, m. the shorter or
lesser Pulastya.
—लघु-पुष्प, अस्, m. a kind of
Kadamba.
—लघु-प्रयत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, using
little effort, indolent, impotent; pronounced with
slight articulation.
—लघु-बदर, अस्, ई, m. f. a
kind of jujube tree.
—लघु-बुद्ध-पुराण, अम्,
n., N. of an epitome of the Lalita-vistara.
—लघु-
बोध, अस्, m. ‘easily understood,’ N. of a grammar.
—लघु-ब्रह्मवैवर्त, अम्, n., N. of an epi-

—लघु-ब्राह्मी, f.
a species of plant.
—लघु-भव, अस्, m. a low
station, humble birth.
—लघु-भागवत, अम्, n.
the short Bhāgavata.
—लघु-भाव, अस्, m. light
state, lightness, ease, facility.
—लघु-भुज्, क्, क्, क्,
eating little.
—लघु-भूषण-कान्ति, इस्, f., N. of
a commentary.
—लघु-भोजन, अम्, n. a light

—लघु-मञ्जूषा, f.,

—लघु-
मांस, अस्, m. ‘having light (i. e. easily digested)

—लघु-मानस, N. of an astronomical work.
—लघु-मित्र, अम्, n. a slight or weak friend, an

—लघु-मूल, अम्, n.
(in algebra) the lesser root of an equation, the least
[]

—लघु-मूलक, अम्, n. a radish.

—लघु-

—लघु-लय, अम्, n. the root of a fragrant

—लघु-ललित-विस्तर,
N. of an extract from the Lalita-vistara.
—लघु-
वसिष्ठ-सिद्धान्त or लघु-वासिष्ठ-सिद्धान्-
त, अस्, m., N. of an epitome of the Vasiṣṭha-sid-

—लघु-वाक्य-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of certain
Vedānta precepts by Śaṅkarācārya.
—लघु-वार्त्-
तिक, अम्, n., N. of the last eight books of the

māṃsā Sūtras by Kumārila.
—लघु-वासस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, thinly or lightly dressed; wearing clean or pure
clothing.
—लघु-विक्रम, अस्, m. a quick step;
(अस्, आ, अम्), having a quick step, quick-footed,
with hasty step, hastening.
—लघु-विवर-त्व,
अम्, n. the state of having a narrow opening.
—लघु-विष्णु, उस्, m. ‘the short Viṣṇu,’ N. of

—ल-

—लघुवृत्ति-ता, f. insignificance, meanness; bad

—लघु-वेधिन्, ई, इनी,

—लघु-वैया-
करण-सिद्धान्त-मञ्जूषा, f., N. of an epitome

—ल-
घु-शमी, f. a kind of Acacia.
—लघु-शान्ति-
पुराण, अम्, n. an epitome of the Śānti-purāṇa.
—लघु-शिखर-ताल, अस्, m., N. of a particular

—लघु-शिवपुराण, अम्, n. the
short Śiva-purāṇa.
—लघु-शौनकी, f. ‘the shorter
Śaunakī, ‘N. of a work.
—लघु-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m.
and लघु-सङ्ग्रहिणी-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of two
works.
—लघु-सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘weak-natured,’
having a weak or fickle character, having an easy
disposition.
—लघुसत्त्व-ता, f. weakness of cha-
racter, fickleness.
—लघु-साङ्ख्य-वृत्ति or ल-
घु-साङ्ख्य-सूत्र-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of an epitome
of the Sāṅkhya-pravacana-bhāṣya.
—लघु-सार,
अस्, आ, अम्, of little importance, insignificant, unim-
portant, worthless.
—लघु-सिद्धान्त-कौमुदी,
f. = लघु-कौमुदी, q. v.
—लघु-सिद्धान्त-
चन्द्रिका, f., N. of a commentary.
—लघु-सुदर्-
शन, अम्, n. a particular medicinal powder.
—ल-
घु-स्यद, अस्, आ, अम्, = रघु-ष्यद्, going quickly.
—लघु-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, light-handed, ready-
handed, active, nimble, expert, clever; (अस्), m. a
good archer.
—लघुहस्त-ता, f. or लघुहस्त-
त्व, अम्, n. ready-handedness, activity, expertness.
—लघुहस्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = लघु-हस्त.
—लघु-हारित, अस्, m. ‘the short Hārīta,’ N. of
a particular recension of Hārīta's law-book.
—लघु-
हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, light-hearted, fickle.
—लघु-
हेम-दुग्धा, f. Ficus Oppositifolia.
—लघू-क-
रण, अम्, n. the act of making light, making less,
lessening, diminishing, diminution; thinking little
of, contemning.
—लघू-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made
light, reduced in weight, made easier or shorter,
abbreviated; lessened, reduced in importance, made
insignificant; thought lightly of.
—लघूक्ति (˚घु-
उक्˚), इस्, f. a brief mode of expression.
—लघूत्-
थान (˚घु-उत्˚) or लघु-समुत्थान, अस्, आ,
अम्, making active efforts, doing work rapidly.
—ल-
घूदुम्बरिका (˚घु-उद्˚), f. Ficus Oppositifolia.
—लघु-अञ्जीर, अम्, n. a small fig.
—लघु-अत्रि,
इस्, m. ‘the short Atri,’ N. of a particular recension
of Atri's law-book.
—लघ्व्-आद्य्-उडुम्बराह्वा
(˚र-आह्˚), f. = लघूदुम्बरिका.
—लघ्व्-आर्य-
सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. an abbreviation of the Ārya-
siddhānta.
—लघु-आशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or लघु-आहार,
[]
अस्, आ, अम्, eating little, making a light repast,
moderate in diet, moderate, abstemious.

लघिमन्, आ, m. lightness, levity, absence of
weight; a kind of सिद्धि or supernatural faculty of
assuming excessive lightness at will; smallness, dimi-
nutiveness, insignificance; frivolousness, fickleness;
meanness, lowness, diminution.

लघीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of लघु), more
quick, very swift; lighter, &c.

लघूय, Nom. P. लघूयति, &c., Ved. to
think lightly of, despise.

लघ्वी, f. a delicate woman, &c. See under
लघु, p. 859, col. 1.

लाघ् लाघ् (= rt. राघ्), cl. 1. A. ला-
घते, &c., to be able or equal to, to
be competent or suffice.

लाघरकोलस लाघरकोलस, अस्, m. a par-
ticular form of jaundice.

लाघव लाघव, अम्, n. (fr. लघु), quick-
ness, swiftness, rapidity, speed; lightness, levity;
activity, alacrity, versatility, dexterity, readiness; ease,
facility; health; littleness, smallness, minuteness,
delicacy, fineness; insignificance, unimportance,
meanness; frivolity, inconsiderateness, rashness; (in
prosody) shortness of a vowel or syllable; shortness
of expression, brevity, conciseness; making light
of, undervaluing, slighting, slight, disrespect, con-
tempt, disgrace.
—लाघवान्वित (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, possessed of brevity.
—लाघवायन (˚व-आय्˚),
अस्, m., N. of an author.

लाघविक, अस्, ई, अम्, being quick or light, being
short or brief.
